text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Stable Angina Pectoris. The ECG showing ST depression during exertion, combined with your description of chest pain radiating to the left arm and jaw triggered by climbing stairs, strongly indicates myocardial ischemia. While your troponin was not provided, the clinical picture fits stable angina rather than an acute myocardial infarction. I recommend starting anti-anginal medication and scheduling a stress test to confirm the diagnosis and assess the extent of coronary artery disease.
